map.输入墙面与顶面面积（或长×宽×高）、涂刷遍数及油漆理论涂布率（㎡/L），估算所需: Enter the wall and ceiling areas (or length x width x height), the number of coats and the theoretical coverage rate (sq m/L) to estimate the total liters of paint needed and the purchase cost, accounting for door and window deductions, helping homeowners control latex paint usage and budget.
map.二手房翻新算两面墙 + 顶面乳胶漆升数，门窗口面积扣除避免买多造成浪费与色差。: For a second-hand home renovation count two walls plus the ceiling in liters of latex paint, and deduct door and window areas to avoid buying too much and causing waste and color differences.
map.按遍数（2 底 + 2 面）与覆盖率 10–12 ㎡/L 估算采购桶数，避免不够: Estimate the number of buckets from the number of coats (2 primer + 2 topcoat) and a coverage of 10-12 sq m/L, avoiding a shortage followed by a batch color difference.
map.不同房间分表面录入（客厅墙 / 卧室墙），分别计价，控制整体涂刷预算。: Enter different rooms by surface (living room walls, bedroom walls) and price them separately to control the overall painting budget.
map.算例（客厅墙 30 + 卧室墙 22 + 顶面 20㎡）: Worked example (living room walls 30 + bedroom walls 22 + ceiling 20 sq m)
map.：合计 72㎡，遍数 2、覆盖率 10 ㎡/L → 用量 = 72×2÷10 =: Total 72 sq m, 2 coats, coverage 10 sq m/L -> usage = 72 x 2 / 10 = 14.4 L; at 5 L per bucket 14.4/5 = 2.88, so 3 buckets, at 280 CNY per bucket about 840 CNY. Door and window deductions are not counted, so in practice 1-2 buckets can be saved (each door or window is about 1.5-2 sq m).
map.覆盖率怎么取？: How is the coverage rate chosen?
map.乳胶漆理论 10–12 ㎡/L/遍，深色 / 多孔墙面取低值；实际损耗另加 10: Latex paint theoretically covers 10-12 sq m/L per coat; take the low value for dark colors or porous walls, and add 10%-15% for real loss. Primer and topcoat coverage differ, so enter them separately.
map.门窗要扣吗？: Should doors and windows be deducted?
map.建议扣除门窗口面积，否则高估 1–2 桶。本工具支持按表面分别录入并汇总，扣除后: Deducting door and window areas is recommended, otherwise you overestimate by 1-2 buckets. This tool supports per-surface entry and totals, which is closer to the real purchase quantity after deduction.
